messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@brightpathhealth.com>, BrightPath Health Procurement <procurement@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Starter credit qualification and activation check-in

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Internal approvals came through for a self-serve starter credit package that matches the pilot profile we discussed. Before I push the credit to your org account there are two quick eligibility checks I need confirmed:

1) Billing contact and PO path for any overage (procurement@brightpathhealth.com is fine if that's still the right address).
2) Primary sandbox team member (we typically make the first 3 seats available to an engineer + PM + security contact).

If both look good I can issue $3,000 in starter credits and a one-week trial extension that will start on issuance. We’ll also enable a usage monitor that will send a short activation report at day 3 and day 7.

Next steps: reply with the billing contact/PO path and the sandbox lead. If you want, I can also schedule a 20-minute kickoff to walk your engineer through token-management and the prefix caching tips that reduce cost.

Attachments: starter-credits-eligibility-terms.pdf (attachment stub)

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Senior GTM Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference runtime

Hi Priya —

Great news, thank you!

1) Procurement route: procurement@brightpathhealth.com — PO process can be completed after we confirm the pilot terms (we have an internal PO template).
2) Sandbox lead: Mateo Cruz (mateo.cruz@brightpathhealth.com), Senior Engineer on Clinical Search.

A 20-minute kickoff would be helpful — Mateo is available Wednesday afternoon PST. Could you include Sergio if there's a technical nuance around KV caching?

Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Starter credit qualification and activation check-in

Hi Alicia / Mateo —

All set on our side. I approved and issued the self-serve package: $3,000 starter credits + a 7-day trial extension attached to the org account for the email domain @brightpathhealth.com. You should see the credit banner in the console; I also attached a short activation playbook that covers initial prompts, caching knobs, and recommended batching.

What I did for you:
- Credits issued: $3,000 (valid 30 days from issuance)
- Trial extension: +7 days to the org free trial window
- Monitoring: enabled automated activation report (day 3 & day 7) to this thread and to procurement@brightpathhealth.com

Attachments (stubs): starter-credits-2026-12-07.pdf, activation-playbook-brief.md

Kickoff: Sergio is available Wed 12/9 at 11:00 AM PST for a 20-minute technical walkthrough; I can send a calendar invite if that works for Mateo.

If you run into low activation at day 3, we have a short checklist we recommend:
- Verify prefix-caching is enabled for inference endpoints
- Use a 128-token generation for initial smoke tests to see latency/cost tradeoffs
- Add one small eval prompt to track quality drift early

Let me know and I'll loop in a solutions engineer for a quick pairing session.

Best,
Priya

Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Quick activation pulse + offer for live pairing

Hi Alicia / Mateo —

Following up with a quick activation pulse: the automated monitor picked up minimal token usage from the org in the first 48 hours (looks like only two short smoke tests). That's totally normal, but I wanted to offer a low-friction pairing session that often unblocks teams — a 30-minute live pairing where our SE watches an initial run and helps tune batching/prefixes in real time.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Fri 12/11, 09:00–09:30
- Mon 12/14, 15:00–15:30

If neither works, we can also send a prioritized checklist and short sample prompts that have helped other clinical search pilots get to 5% daily activation within 48 hours.

Quick FAQ:
Q: Will pairing help reduce expected spend?
A: Yes — things like KV reuse and reducing repeated prompt context typically cut per-session token costs by 20–40% on these pilots.

If you want the pairing, reply with the slot and we'll send a calendar invite and temporary join link.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Evelyn.Hart@redwoodinference.com
